newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jobs can increase without inflation -- Herman.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jobs can increase without inflation -- Herman.

text.p: U.S. Labor Secretary Alexis Herman said Friday that jobs can continue to grow in the United States without sparking inflation.
"We can continue to create jobs ... and not create inflationary pressures," she said in an interview with CNBC.
Herman said the latest data was "good news" for the American worker and the American economy.

"I think if we can continue to have the same consistent growth that we have seen in adding new jobs to the economy along with the consistent gains that we are seeing with the wage rate, that we are doing very well," Herman said.
Herman said there have been some reports of shortages of skilled labor in some parts of the country, but that the department does not have "any evidence of that being the reality."
She said there were areas of the country where workers were in greater demand and areas where people are looking for jobs in greater numbers.
"It is a very mixed picture," Herman said.
